desc: Reduce f(L,R) to (# distinct values in A[L..R]) minus (# adjacent value pairs v,v+1 both present), and confirm via brute force on small cases.

Design the summation method: right-end sweep maintaining f(L,R) for all L as R grows, with delta = 1 - [x-1 present] - [x+1 present] applied via O(1) length-weighted contributions keyed on last-occurrence positions.
Implement the right-end sweep in Python with fast stdin/stdout I/O, handling p=0 sentinels and large answer values.
Verify the three sample inputs produce 16, 23, 129 (all passed) and finalize the submission code.
